a.name: Owner's letter
a.description: Mark J's London review on a raised letter card, his own photo from the site at its left, a brass quote mark and a signed foot.
a.differs_from: One review with the reviewer's own photo on a raised card; S1 gives one review room with no photo and no frame, S2 and S3 are grids.

b.name: Two London notes
b.description: A sunk tray opening on a wide photo of Vennie, then the two London reviews stacked one per slot, the second stepped in.
b.differs_from: Two reviews stacked in one column under a section photo, in a sunk tray; the built rows carry no photo and sit plain or on a band.

c.name: Kennel wall
c.description: A photo of Jones bleeds to the right edge of the page; a bone plate overlaps it with the question and Rachel L.'s review set large.
c.differs_from: A single review on a plate over a credited photo that bleeds to the page edge; the built rows have no photo and a plain or band frame.
